'''Trepler Darklighter''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a member of the [[Darklighter family/Legends|Darklighter family]].

==Biography==
Originally from [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], Darklighter built his own wealth&mdash;rumors said through smuggling.<ref name="GG7" /> He owned [[Docking Bay 86]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|168|Darklighter, Trepler}}</ref> though he lefts its management up to [[BX-9T]], an administrative droid, as he spent most of his time away on resort worlds.<ref name="GG7" /> He was distantly related to [[Huff Darklighter|Huff]] and [[Jula Darklighter]], and he allowed his relatives to occasionally use his docking bay.<ref name="TBW" /> When [[Gavin Darklighter]] joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], this privilege was extended to New Republic officials on business to Tatooine by the other Darklighters; it was regarded as the Darklighter family dock and it was possible that Trepler had passed the docking bay on to his relatives.<ref name="TBW" /><ref name="Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>
